name: Pristella Calnart
original_name: プリステラ・カルナート
source:
A girl who is a close friend of Mina and Mizuki. Stella is characterized by her straightforward personality and an elegant manner of speech. She loves cooking, but every dish she makes turns out deathly sweet. Most people are afraid of her and call her meals a "headache-causing mystery drug".

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20040816084928/http://active-soft.jp/catalog/lostmind.html]official website[/url].]
